{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''branch''' of the [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] [[Celebratus Archive]] had been established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fusai/Legends|Fusai]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Its data vaults hosted [[Mistress Mnemos]], a [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]]. Before the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established Fusai as a safeworld, and its library became one of their great analysis assets.
